The '''Cargo Master Z-24 Heavy Speeder Truck''' was manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]. It was a large flatbed [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder truck]] similar in design to the [[Cargo Master Z-12 Speeder Truck]]. It had three rear-mounted [[Engine/Legends|engines]], a large cargo capacity and forward cab. The vehicle was the mainstay of the [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]] ground fleet.
